snippet.title: Onlne Kolorup — Match & Stack | Free card game: match ranks, call Go or Stop
snippet.description:
Kolorup — Match & Stack just got its 1.1.0 update: sign in with Google in one tap, collect a daily bonus, and spin the wheel once a day for a coin prize.

It is a quick two-player card game. Match ranks on the table, collect colour combos, then decide: Stop and take the pot, or Go for a bigger one — against AI opponents or real people online.

Come and play — it is free, and it runs in your browser too.

PLAY IT FREE
• Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.blackmine.kolorup
• In your browser, no install: https://webgame.blackmine.studio/kolorup/

NEW IN 1.1.0
• Sign in with Google — your coins and progress follow the account
• A daily bonus every day you play, plus a free daily spin
• Step away in the middle of a hand and the table plays on for you
• Combo cards dance when you score, and 16 emotes to send your opponent
• Clearer markers on your hand and bigger cards in your collection

WHAT YOU SEE HERE
Recorded in-game at 1080p60 — the lobby, the four rooms, a real hand, a combo, the daily bonus, the daily spin and the win screen.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Each turn, play one card from your hand, then flip one from the deck.
• Cards capture by rank. If your card matches one on the table, you take both.
• Calls like Echo, Resonance and Vacuum each take a chaff card from your opponent. A Collision locks three cards on the table for whoever takes them later.
• Reach 9 Pack and choose: Stop to win the pot now, or Go to play on for a bigger one. If your opponent reaches 9 Pack while you are pushing, they win outright.

COLLECT COMBOS
• A 52-card deck in four shapes — stars, circles, ellipses and triangles — plus bonus B cards.
• Seven colour combos: Purple, Red and Gold on the stars; Orange, Green, Blue and Rainbow on the circles.
• Chaff Bust and repeated Go calls multiply the pot.

PLAY ONLINE
• Sign in with Google in one tap, or with an ID and password. Your coins and progress follow the account.
• Collect a daily bonus every day you play, and spin once a day for a coin prize.
• Step away in the middle of a hand and the table plays on for you — take your seat back any time.

ROOMS AND PROGRESS
• Pick a room by stake: 10, 50, 100 or 200 coins. Higher rooms bring sharper opponents, and the top rooms open at level 30 and 50.
• Every AI opponent has its own play style and skill level.
• Earn XP each game, level up for coin rewards, and track your plays, wins, win rate and best pot.

FREE TO PLAY
• Single play is always available against AI opponents.
• Coins are play money for Kolorup only. They have no cash value and cannot be exchanged or withdrawn.
• Free top-ups when you run out, and optional rewarded ads for more.
• Optional in-app purchase: a 5,000 coin pack.
